attchmntText: Health X Platform Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Health X Platform Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The standalone net loss after tax was 31.85 lakhs for the quarter and 83.28 lakhs for the half year. Basic loss per share was 0.10 rupees for the quarter and 0.26 rupees for the half year. Total assets stood at 27,025.77 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. The company is pursuing a Composite Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation involving Microsec Resources Private Limited, Innogrow Technologies Limited, and Sastasundar Healthbuddy Limited. This scheme is subject to requisite approvals and has not yet been accounted for in the financial results. Expenses of 14.75 lakhs related to the scheme were incurred in the previous quarter. The statutory auditor issued a clean limited review report on the financial statements.

attchmntText: Health X Platform Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Schedule of the Earnings Conference Call for Q2 of FY2026-27 and registration Link thereof
voiceSummary: Health X Platform Limited has scheduled an Analyst and Investors Earnings Conference Call for Monday, 16th November, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST. The call will discuss financial performance and business updates for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, of FY2026-27. Participants must pre-register via the provided link to receive login details. The universal dial-in numbers are plus 91 22 6280 1557 and plus 91 22 7115 8383. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. Only information available in the public domain will be shared, with no unpublished price sensitive information disclosed. This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.
